heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 101–510, div. A, title XV, § 1532(b)(1), (2), Nov. 5, 1990, 104 Stat. 1733

notes.text: Section 48, act Mar. 3, 1883, ch. 130, § 9, 22 Stat. 565, related to borrowing money on credit of Soldiers’ Home.
Section 49, R.S. §§ 4814, 4821, related to persons entitled to membership in and benefits of Soldiers’ Home.
Section 50, R.S. § 4822, related to persons excluded from benefits of Soldiers’ Home.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective one year after Nov. 5, 1990, see section 1541(a) of Pub. L. 101–510, formerly set out as an Effective Date note under section 401 of this title.
